seg: He numbers the stars and he calls them by name.
He watches the sparrow and the nest once it came.
He cuts for the lilies, so lovely to see, because he loves them so, I know he loves me.
He watches the lambs in the fall where days live. He cares for the shepherd watching over his sheep.
He knows his creations, wherever they may be
Because he loves them so, I know he loves me.
He numbers the stars on our tears and our smiles. He knows every star and he knows every child.
And when I see starlight, or birds of the wind, I know my father loves me, and my heart it sings.
I know my father loves me ond my heart sins.
